rules.preferred: Counterparty must not retain majority ownership/control of Licensee
rules.hard_ceiling: Never accept >=50% ownership or control by licensor/counterparty

rules.preferred: No automatic accelerator equity with anti-dilution floor without board approval
rules.hard_ceiling: Flag seed equity grants bundled into IP licenses
rules.fallback_text: Any equity grant to an accelerator shall be subject to Licensee's board approval and shall not include a permanent anti-dilution floor without written waiver.

rules.hard_ceiling: Change-of-control fees require CFO + legal approval
Flag non-UK governing law on vendor/inbound paper
rules.fallback_text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.
match_any: laws of the State of California

rules.preferred: Mutual, capped indemnity aligned to fees
rules.hard_ceiling: No uncapped or one-sided broad indemnification of university/licensor
rules.fallback_text: Each party's aggregate indemnification obligations shall not exceed the fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

rules.hard_ceiling: Documents marked non-negotiable need senior counsel

rules.preferred: Queue items should be counterparty commercial contracts
rules.hard_ceiling: Teaching templates / conversation guides are out of routine vendor review
